takes.title: Lean Forward and Mime Loosening a Bolt
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps into a staggered stance, leans over the hands, and repeats short turning motions at waist height. They straighten and lower both hands at the end.

takes.title: Lean Forward and Mime Tightening a Bolt
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches forward, repeats low hand turns while looking down, then draws the arms back and returns upright.

takes.title: Mime Sawing with Short Repeated Strokes
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps in, leans forward, and moves one hand back and forth while keeping the other low and forward. They straighten and lower their arms.

takes.title: Mime Turning a Screw with the Elbow Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans to one side with one elbow raised and works the hands close together near the waist. They release the pose, turn slightly, and finish upright.

takes.title: Mime Turning a Screw and Lower the Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps into a narrow staggered stance, keeps one elbow out, and makes compact rotations near the waist. They stand upright again at the end.

takes.title: Mime Unscrewing with Repeated Hand Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans over the hands and makes a sustained series of small rotations with one elbow held out. The hands lower as they straighten.

takes.title: Mime Hammering with Low Strokes
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps toward the work area, leans over their hands, and repeats short downward arm motions. They release the stance and straighten.

takes.title: Mime Hammering from a Narrow Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps in with one arm low, repeats compact downward motions over the forward hand, and steps back into a relaxed stance.

takes.title: Mime Pulling a Nail and Step Back
takes.actionDescription: The performer turns toward the work area, brings both hands in front, makes a pulling motion, and lowers the arms while stepping away.

takes.title: Mime a Hammering Sequence while Bent Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends at the waist and works low in front of the body for several strokes, adjusting the torso between groups. They straighten and step away at the end.

takes.title: Mime Cleaning Up with Several Floor Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer turns and steps between brief arm gestures and repeated deep bends toward the floor. They straighten and finish facing away.

takes.title: Mime a Drink with a Small Backward Lean
takes.actionDescription: The performer turns away, brings a hand toward the face with a small backward lean, then lowers the hand and steps sideways.

takes.title: Mime Lifting, Carrying, and Setting Down a Stool
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches down with both hands, straightens and steps while holding the arms forward, then bends deeply to lower them. The CMU source identifies a stool.

takes.title: Mime Opening an Umbrella Close to the Body
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches low, brings both hands together in front of the torso, and raises one hand near the face. They finish with that hand still lifted.

takes.title: Mime Opening an Umbrella with a Higher Hand Lift
takes.actionDescription: The performer extends one hand, draws both hands in front of the torso, then lifts one hand toward the forehead and holds briefly.

takes.title: Mime Closing an Umbrella and Lowering It
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand raised near the head, brings both hands in front to make a compact lowering motion, and finishes upright.

takes.title: Mime Opening and Closing an Umbrella
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one hand beside the head, lowers it toward both hands in front, and separates the arms before returning upright.

takes.title: Mime Closing a Box with Compact Hand Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches forward and makes a brief inward hand motion at waist level, then returns to standing with arms down. The CMU source identifies a box.

takes.title: Mime Opening a Box and Leaning toward It
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes a short forward hand motion, bends deeply to look and reach down, and then straightens. The CMU source identifies opening a box.

takes.sourceDescription: closing, moving and opening a box
takes.title: Mime Closing, Moving, and Reopening a Box
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches down, turns and steps with a raised arm, then pivots into a second forward bend before straightening. The CMU source identifies the object as a box.

takes.title: Mime Coiling a Rope with Alternating Hand Lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates lifting a hand beside the face and drawing both hands together near the chest. The CMU source identifies coiling a rope.

takes.title: Move the Limbs through a Calibration Sequence
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, bends the elbows, extends a leg to one side, and dips into a squat. They finish upright with both arms open.

takes.title: Mime Tightening a Bolt with a Brief Deep Bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches forward and bends deeply, straightens into compact turning motions, then lowers the arms. The CMU source identifies tightening a bolt.

takes.sourceDescription: bolt tightening, with putting bolt in
takes.title: Mime Inserting a Bolt and Tightening It
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps in, folds over the hands for several repeated manipulations, and rises to finish with one hand near the chest.

takes.title: Mime Loosening a Bolt from a Deep Forward Lean
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends forward with both hands in front for several compact turning motions, then stands upright and releases the arms.
